subject: Huge refactor, see doobly * Got rid of (most) public singletons, now dependencies directly injected by App class (private singletons remain for static safetyhook callbacks) - this will let us to do proper mocking/testing later and clarified object lifetimes & hierarchy of dependencies. * Completely refactored how GUIElements and OptionalCheats are organised and constructed (using a bunch of magic_enum / macro magic). * Added local DIContainer class for passing dependencies to OptionalCheat constructors. * Added ScopedCallback that RAII'ifies the eventpp events and handles. * Unit tests for DIContainer and ScopedCallback. * IAnchorPoint , right now just used to locate MessagesGUI on screen relative to main gui. Can be used for eg DisplayPlayerData later. * Refactored GameStateHook -> MCCStateHook that gets more game info, and uses better loading hooks/flags. * Rejigged out internal gets hcmDirPath on startup, still not sure on it. --- lots of issues remain: * Randomly crashes on startup about half the time for various reasons. * Randomly crashes on shutdown about half the time for various other reasons. * Too many shared_ptrs where unique or weak would be better. * Still no good solution to static callback running after owning class destroyed (tried make_shared_from_this stuff but has it's own issues). * RPCClientInternal::sendFatalInternalError totally broken for some reason. * HCMExternal still doesn't re-inject on second mcc opening .

subject: This is a real in-the-weeds commit, I'm working thru a lot of issues rn. Cp dumping is kinda working, injection is not. My real struggle has been the rpc stuff, and the reason I'm committing this is that I think I want to change how I'm doing that. Right now interproc sets up an rpc server to comm with internal, but then needs to use callbacks to comm with external. Having this interproc middleman is giving me a huge headache, so I think I'll look to use some other rpc library where I can just setup the rpc server directly in external.
